\chapter{Build the Work Label and Values}
\label{ch:pa-form-work-runway}
\hlchaptermodality{20}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise and copy the Gurmukhi work label and two separately practised neutral values.}

The learner assembles the work label and copies two neutral values after each new Gurmukhi piece has received its own bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[ka]{\pa{ਕ} — one new base for the work label}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-ka}



\begin{quote}
Write the familiar \textbf{\pa{ਮ}} once and place the familiar nasal mark \textbf{\pa{ੰ}} above it once. Today adds only one base letter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} slowly twice. Say \emph{ka}. Do not build the whole label yet.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and write \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} once. Compare only the base shape and repair one difference.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after this one new base.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[kamm]{\pa{ਕੰਮ} — assemble the work label}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-label}



\begin{quote}
Touch the pieces in order: \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}, \textbf{\pa{ੰ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਮ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਮ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one label}
Join \textbf{\pa{ਕ} + \pa{ੰ} + \pa{ਮ} + \pa{ਮ} = \pa{ਕੰਮ}}. On this beginner form, \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}} labels the work line. Copy the label once and leave its answer blank.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the label and say what information belongs there. Do not add a value yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This is a closed practice form, not a request for real personal information.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[kha]{\pa{ਖ} — one new base for a work value}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-kha}



\begin{quote}
Write \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} once. Today adds a different base; compare the two without naming a whole word.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਖ}} slowly twice. Say \emph{kha}. Keep its shape separate from \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and write \textbf{\pa{ਖ}} once. Repair only the base shape.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One new base is enough.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[khetī]{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ} — assemble one work value}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-farming}



\begin{quote}
Touch \textbf{\pa{ਖ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ੇ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਤ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ੀ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one value}
Build \textbf{\pa{ਖੇ} + \pa{ਤੀ} = \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}. It means “farming.” Copy \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} once.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model, say the meaning, and write the value once. Reveal it and repair one piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Only this value is scored today.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[au-matra]{\pa{ੌ} — one new vowel sign}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-au-matra}



\begin{quote}
Write the familiar base \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} once. Keep the top line clear.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace the vowel sign \textbf{\pa{ੌ}} twice. Attach it to \textbf{\pa{ਨ}} once: \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ}}. The mark belongs above the base.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and write \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ}} once. Repair only the new sign or its placement.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Do not build the whole value yet.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[naukarī]{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ} — assemble the other work value}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-job}



\begin{quote}
Touch the known pieces \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਰੀ}} in order.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one value}
Join \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ} + \pa{ਕ} + \pa{ਰੀ} = \pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}. It means “job.” Copy \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} once.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model, say the meaning, and write the value once. Repair only the first differing piece.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The two values remain separate until the next lesson.
\end{tcolorbox}
